name: gdn_mega_bwd_tp_v7
changes: Reuse forward blocked triangular solve on both vector subcores and Cube
Pipeline native preparation with all cache modes
Load gate/beta panels and transpose instead of scalar GM gathers
Native FP32 vector prefix scan; FP32-input accuracy path retained
Compute shared QK/KK once per key-head group; keep K/KK read-only aliases
paired_method: Identical rounded inputs, alternating snapshot/current order in one process; three warmup pairs, eleven measured pairs. Synchronized wall time includes allocation/enqueue.
stage_trace_note: Hardware trace durations, not Cube utilization counters.

validation.bound: Per gradient tensor max error <= 2 * reordered PyTorch max error + 1e-5
validation.added_coverage: Packed [17,0,19] H64/Hk16 exercises grouped scheduling/aliases across three dtypes and three cache modes.

extensive_notes: 80 backward configurations measured with five samples per case and full recomputation.
Forward measurements are reused from v6: code unchanged; timings were collected separately.
Both directions report synchronized wall time. Backward includes allocation; forward uses preallocated buffers.
TP divides both global head counts; communication is excluded.
Forward unsupported for local value heads 2,4,6: corresponding 20 cells retain N/A.
